environment.description: ECS Fargate service with identical container image deployed behind CloudFront distribution (behavior origin pointing to internal ALB). CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d6-5758f4bb5765) that injects 'Content-Security-Policy' header with 'require-sri-for script style; default-src self; script-src cdn.example.com' directives. The CDN serves dashboard-actions.js and jquery with integrity attributes enforced at the edge via CloudFront Function (event type: viewer-response) that rewrites HTML script tags to include integrity='sha384-...' and crossorigin='anonymous' attributes before delivery. Additionally, the same Response Headers Policy sets 'Set-Cookie' header modifications via custom headers adding 'SameSite=Strict; Secure' suffix to all Set-Cookie response headers through a CloudFront Function on viewer-response events. The ALB is in a private subnet accessible only from the CloudFront prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing), preventing direct access that would bypass these edge controls.

config.csp_header: require-sri-for script style; default-src 'self'; script-src cdn.example.com
config.cookie_rewrite: appends SameSite=Strict; Secure to all Set-Cookie headers
